name: General Rajaxx
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/ruins-of-ahnqiraj/general-rajaxx.md. The event is modelled as eight phases: seven waves and Rajaxx. The boss entity stands for each wave's officer in turn (Qeez, Tuubid, Drenn, Xurrem, Yeggeth, Pakkon, Zerran) and a phase's `hpFrom` 1 to `hpTo` 0 is that officer's life, so the health bar resets each wave; the fixed clock means no officer can actually live through a wave or be polymorphed, and the 'next wave only after this wave dies or a 2-3 minute timer' rule (research conflict: 3 min Wowhead/CMaNGOS, 2 min AzerothCore) is not modelled: each wave gets a flat 40 s (estimate) and Rajaxx 130 s, because a 20-minute rehearsal would not hold attention. The two big unknowns stand: real time-to-kill per wave and how far the terrace really is (the rectangle is unmeasured). Boss melee (700 per 2 s) is scaled so a 10,000 HP tank lives on the raid's passive healing and dies if a player healer ignores it (`healPerSecondWithPlayerHealer` 60). The same `meleeDamage` serves every officer and Rajaxx because the engine has one boss melee number per script; Needlers and Warriors do no damage (engine gap: adds cannot hurt anyone), so their damage is folded into that number. Wave trash uses each wave's real counts as a single killable pack of 6 held by the off-tank role; there is no Needler versus Warrior kill order. Kill order is 'officer first', which is correct for the unpolymorphed case (polymorph is not modelled). Thundercrash is an `aoe` plus radial `knockback` plus `threatWipe`, 12 s then every 21 s (emulator). Its real damage is half of current health (minimum 100, 40-50% by Warcraft Tavern), which the engine cannot express; a flat 3,500 is used so a full-health 10,000 HP tank drops by about a third per crash, which reads like repeated halves when a tank is not topped off. The real hit is half of current health, so it cannot kill above about 100 HP; the sim's flat 3,500 can, which the tip states. Knockback 14 yd (unknown; spell data 100-250 value), and phase 8 tanks in the south-west corner of the terrace (tank at (-45, -29), about 3 yd from both walls; the door gap is x -9 to 9), the only spot where, with him arriving from the east, the push really is stopped: the wall absorbs it and the tank moves about 2 yd. The research's open question on radius (spell data 100 yd vs TenTonHammer about 20 yd) is resolved as the whole room. Disarm (10 s then every 22 s, 5 s): a debuff shown on the tank plus a 20% threat cut (a placeholder; the real effect is the loss of weapon threat for 5 s). 'Deaggro' is folded into Thundercrash's threat reset (the research cannot say whether it is separate). Frenzy at 30% (BigWigs option 8269; Wowhead 8269: +60% melee haste, +50 physical damage, 2 min, no dispel type) is an `enrage` at 91 s (70% of the 130 s clock), with `boss.enrageMultiplier` 1.6 for the haste and the flat damage folded in. Officer lessons, every one an approximation: Qeez' Frightening Shout is a 12 yd `fear` on random non-tanks, 4.5 s (wiki). UNVERIFIED: its fear radius and exact spell ID (the wiki gives the duration only; spell 19134 on Wowhead is the warrior Intimidating Shout and may be a different spell), and the 12 yd is unmeasured. Tuubid's Attack Order (10 s dummy aura, Wowhead 25471 and the DBM and BigWigs target bars; all adds fixate one target) is a 10 s `carried` hazard on a random raider, because adds cannot be made to fixate a target; it scores whether the marked raider took it away from the group. Drenn's Lightning Cloud (Wowhead 26550: instant, 30 yd range, a persistent 15 s cloud, 10 yd radius, 657-843 Nature on landing and every 3 s) is a `hazard` on a random player or raid dot: 1 s warning, 15 s active, `tick` 250 per second standing in for about 750 per 3 s; hazards hit only the player, so the ghost tank does not take it and there is no Andorov to pull clear. Xurrem's Shockwave (Wowhead 25425: instant, Nature 1,313 base, 20 yd radius, 2 s stun) is an instant `aoe` of radius 17 from his 3.5 yd hitbox (20 yd centre to centre), 1,300 with `stun` 2: melee and the tank cannot avoid it and heal through it, and ranged and healers stand outside 20 yd (`shockwaveHits`, spots `rangedXurrem` and `healerXurrem`). Yeggeth's Shield of Rajaxx (Wowhead 25282: 6 s, immune to every school) is a `shield` for all DPS with no reflect, so the only rule is stop attacking; the engine's `shield` also blocks attacks on the wave's adds, whereas a real raid would turn to the Needlers for those 6 seconds. Pakkon's Sweeping Slam (Wowhead 25322: 1,750 base, 15 yd radius, knockback) is a 16 yd frontal `cone` for 2,000 with knockback; he must face away from the raid. Zerran's Enlarge is a dispellable `debuff` on the tank that raises damage taken by 40%, because a buff on an enemy add cannot be dispelled in this engine. Lieutenant General Andorov and his four Kaldorei Elite are not on the board. Their real contribution (Andorov re-taking Rajaxx after a Thundercrash, Aura of Command's 200 per 3 s and haste, Kaldorei damage) is only reflected in generous passive healing; the healer has no way to heal them and no mechanic loses them. The 140 versus 150 Cenarion Circle reputation choice and the release-and-rejoin trick are out of scope. Each wave here costs a threat reset on the boss so the tank re-acquires the next officer, a stand-in for the real gaps between waves.

labels.text: Back into this corner for Thundercrash
Waves come in from the north side

raidSpotP1.label: Raid: back to the south wall

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Each wave you take the officer off his arrival path and hold him facing away from the raid. On Rajaxx tank in the south-west corner with your back to the wall, re-take him the moment Thundercrash wipes threat, and do not let him turn on the raid. At 30% he frenzies: 60% faster swings until he dies. (The Taunt button stands for regaining threat.)

offtank.label: Wave off-tank
offtank.description: Your job is the trash pack of every wave: Needlers and Warriors. Grab them as they come in and hold them away from the raid until they die.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Kill the officer first, then Needlers. Step out of Lightning Cloud, take Shockwave and heal through it (it stuns you for 2 s), stand behind Pakkon, and stop attacking through Shield of Rajaxx. On Rajaxx stop for a few seconds after every Thundercrash.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Kill the officer first. Stand outside 20 yards of Xurrem on wave four. Stop attacking through Shield of Rajaxx on wave five. Dispel Enlarge off wave seven instantly. On Rajaxx stop after every Thundercrash until the tank has him back.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Spread so one fear does not take two healers. Stand outside 20 yards of Xurrem on wave four. Dispel Enlarge. Rajaxx: Thundercrash halves everyone, so heal the tank up the moment it lands and keep the raid topped. At 30% he frenzies: 60% faster swings until he dies.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment the boss turns on the raid, never while it is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Every attack adds threat. Watch the bar: in the red band one more hit pulls the boss off the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A big heal on the tank. Have it landing as the spike hits, not after.

dispel.label: Dispel
dispel.tip: Dispel Magic or Purge. Removes Enlarge.

intimidatingShout.label: Frightening Shout
intimidatingShout.tip: A short-range AoE fear. Melee take it; ranged and healers stay out of range; a feared raider runs into the pack.

attackOrder.label: Attack Order
attackOrder.tip: Tuubid marks a raider for 10 seconds and his whole wave fixates them. If it is you, walk away from the raid until they die.

lightningCloud.label: Lightning Cloud
lightningCloud.tip: Drenn drops a 10 yd lightning cloud for 15 s: about 750 on landing and 750 every 3 s. Step out of it.

shockwave.label: Shockwave
shockwave.tip: Instant 20 yd Nature blast that stuns for 2 s. Ranged and healers stand outside 20 yd; melee and tank heal through it.

blessingProtection.label: Shield of Rajaxx
blessingProtection.toast: Shield of Rajaxx: he is immune to everything. Stop attacking.
blessingProtection.tip: He is immune to every school for 6 seconds. Stop attacking until it fades.

sweepingSlam.label: Sweeping Slam
sweepingSlam.tip: A heavy frontal cone with knockback. Face him away from the raid, and melee stand behind him.

enlarge.label: Enlarge
enlarge.tip: A magic buff on him and his allies that raises physical damage. Dispel Magic or Purge it off immediately.

thundercrash.label: Thundercrash
thundercrash.tip: Real Thundercrash halves your current HP, so it cannot kill you. The danger is the next swing. The sim uses a flat 3,500. It knocks everyone away and wipes threat, so let the tank take him back before you attack.

thundercrashWipe.label: Thundercrash: threat wiped
thundercrashWipe.toast: Thundercrash: threat wiped. Tank, get him back.
thundercrashWipe.tip: Threat is gone. Nobody attacks until the tank has him.

disarm.label: Disarm
disarm.tip: Five seconds without your weapon, about 20% of your threat for the moment. Shout and Sunder through it.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.toast: Frenzy: Rajaxx hits faster until he dies
frenzy.tip: At 30% he frenzies: +60% attack speed and +50 per hit. It cannot be dispelled.

waveAdds1.label: Captain Qeez's wave
waveAdds1.tip: 2 Needlers and 4 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive2.label: Captain Tuubid arrives
arrive2.toast: Wave 2: Captain Tuubid comes in from the left
arrive2.tip: Captain Tuubid walks in with 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Attack Order marks one target. If it is you, take the pack away from the raid.

waveAdds2.label: Captain Tuubid's wave
waveAdds2.tip: 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive3.label: Captain Drenn arrives
arrive3.toast: Wave 3: Captain Drenn comes in from the right
arrive3.tip: Captain Drenn walks in with 5 Needlers and 1 Warrior. Lightning Cloud: a 10 yard cloud lands on a raider and stays for 15 seconds. Step out of it.

waveAdds3.label: Captain Drenn's wave
waveAdds3.tip: 5 Needlers and 1 Warrior. Hold them off the raid.

arrive4.label: Captain Xurrem arrives
arrive4.toast: Wave 4: Captain Xurrem comes in from the further left
arrive4.tip: Captain Xurrem walks in with 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Shockwave: instant, 20 yards, and it stuns for 2 seconds. Ranged and healers stand outside 20 yards; melee and tank heal through it.

waveAdds4.label: Captain Xurrem's wave
waveAdds4.tip: 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive5.label: Major Yeggeth arrives
arrive5.toast: Wave 5: Major Yeggeth comes in from the further right
arrive5.tip: Major Yeggeth walks in with 4 Needlers and 2 Warriors. Shield of Rajaxx: he is immune to everything for 6 seconds. Stop attacking.

waveAdds5.label: Major Yeggeth's wave
waveAdds5.tip: 4 Needlers and 2 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive6.label: Major Pakkon arrives
arrive6.toast: Wave 6: Major Pakkon comes in from the deep left
arrive6.tip: Major Pakkon walks in with 2 Needlers and 4 Warriors. Sweeping Slam: he must face away from the raid. Melee behind him.

waveAdds6.label: Major Pakkon's wave
waveAdds6.tip: 2 Needlers and 4 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive7.label: Colonel Zerran arrives
arrive7.toast: Wave 7: Colonel Zerran comes in from the deep right
arrive7.tip: Colonel Zerran walks in with 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Enlarge: dispel it off him the moment it lands.

waveAdds7.label: Colonel Zerran's wave
waveAdds7.tip: 3 Needlers and 3 Warriors. Hold them off the raid.

arrive8.label: General Rajaxx arrives
arrive8.toast: General Rajaxx: "Impudent fool! I will kill you myself!"
arrive8.tip: He walks in after Zerran dies. Take him to the wall.

expectations.tip: Stand on the far side of him so his front points away from the raid, and keep him there.

expectations.tip: Dispel Magic or Purge straight away. Every second it is up the tank takes 40% more.

expectations.label: Take Rajaxx as he walks in
expectations.tip: He comes straight in. Pull him to your wall and hold him there.

expectations.label: Tank Rajaxx in the south-west corner
expectations.tip: Your back to the wall means the Thundercrash knockback is short for you and the boss is not dragged across the room.

expectations.label: Taunt him back after Thundercrash
expectations.tip: Threat is gone. Taunt instantly and turn him away from the raid.

expectations.label: Keep your back to the wall
expectations.tip: Thundercrash throws you 14 yards away from him. A wall behind you makes that a step.

expectations.label: Stay ready beside the wall
expectations.tip: Hold the side position ready for the next Thundercrash if the tank needs help picking him up.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: In the red band one more hit can pull. Wait for the tank.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Every global you can safely use, use. Stop only when the bar is red or the boss is not on the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Nothing on the ground is worth a global. Step out, then carry on.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: A heal on a full tank is a heal you did not have for the spike.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with Enlarge up
debuffSeconds.tip: Dispel Enlarge the moment it lands.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds loose on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

attackOrdersOnRaid.label: Attack Orders carried into the raid
attackOrdersOnRaid.tip: Take it away from the raid.

slamsOnRaid.label: Sweeping Slams on the raid
slamsOnRaid.tip: Keep him facing away from the raid.

thundercrashOffWall.label: Thundercrashes taken away from the wall
thundercrashOffWall.tip: Tank him with your back to the south wall so the knockback is short.

cues.notes: Taunt Rajaxx back after every Thundercrash; pick up each wave; dispel Enlarge.

list.tip: The moment the boss turns, Taunt. Every second it is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with a spike coming is where tanks die. Heal now.

drills.name: Thundercrash recovery
drills.description: Thundercrash every 12 s. Taunt Rajaxx back the moment threat is wiped.

drills.name: Lightning Cloud and Shockwave
drills.description: Step out of each Lightning Cloud and get back on the target. Shockwave cannot be avoided in melee: take it and heal through the stun.

drills.name: Attack Order
drills.description: You may be the marked raider: walk it away from the raid.

drills.name: Wave pickup

drills.name: Healing Thundercrash
